test_title: PYST 40: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The most recent studies on the human body are likely to alter the face of health sciences.

options.text: The most recent studies on the human body are likely to be altered by the face of health sciences.
The face of health sciences will be altering the most recent studies on the human body.
The face of health sciences is likely to be altered by the most recent studies on the human body.
The most face of health sciences is likely to alter the recent studies on the human body.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The face of health sciences is likely to be altered by the most recent studies on the human body.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Active Voice describes a sentence where the subject performs the action stated by the verb. While in the Passive Voice, subject is acted upon by the verb.
 
• The given sentence is written in the Present simple tense.
 
• The structure of **active **voice = **Subject + V1 + s/es + object**__
 
• The structure of **passive **Voice = **__Object + is/am/are + V3 + by + subject__**
 
• Rules of Conversion from Active to Passive Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form of the verb.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Thus the passive voice will be: *The face of health sciences is likely to be altered by the most recent studies on the human body.*
